notes: Added required stories for FEAT-4 with full coverage.

STORY-FEAT4-001.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema
STORY-FEAT4-001.description: Create structured response contract for provider details including NPI data, name, specialties, addresses, and external links (state board, research sites).

STORY-FEAT4-002.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
STORY-FEAT4-002.description: Build core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider data, and normalize fields into internal schema.

STORY-FEAT4-003.title: Construct External Provider Links
STORY-FEAT4-003.description: Generate state medical board URLs and research-related links based on provider state and identifiers.

STORY-FEAT4-004.title: Expose Provider Detail via EvaluateCare Facade
STORY-FEAT4-004.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and tool routing for chat-based access.

STORY-FEAT4-005.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
STORY-FEAT4-005.description: Create tests for NPI lookup, response formatting, and facade integration including error handling for missing or invalid NPIs.
